description: Defines the 'Article' class representing articles within the domain layer of the application, including properties for identification, content, author, comments, tags, and favorites.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties such as title, description, content, author, comments, tags, and favorite status.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has been favorited by checking if 'ArticleFavorites' list is not empty.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the article has been favorited.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Provides a list of tag identifiers associated with the article, filtering out null tag IDs.
